name: ASAS Blueprint Task Register Index
note: The authoritative source states that registers/tasks.json contains all 114 playbook tasks across platform pre-phase P and delivery phases, plus recurring rituals. This index deliberately does not invent task bodies that have not been extracted and reconciled from the source package.
canonicalization_requirements: Every task keeps its permanent source ID.
Task contract and acceptance evidence must be preserved.
No task is marked implementation-ready until dependencies and applicable gates are resolved.
Counts, IDs, references, and provenance must validate against the source before promotion.
